# CareRev

> > CareRev is a healthcare staffing platform connecting nurses and healthcare professionals with flexible per diem shifts across multiple states.

CareRev provides a mobile app-based marketplace for per diem nursing work, enabling registered nurses, nurse practitioners, CNAs, and respiratory therapists to find flexible shifts while helping healthcare facilities manage staffing needs. The platform operates across states including Florida, Nevada, Oklahoma, and Hawaii, with a focus on work-life balance and professional development.
